beats.name: ast: the safe one: signals, steers neatly round the puddle
rea: doesn't care: rides slowly straight in, stops in the middle of it, rides on
sor: the e-bike: never pedals, the bike floats him over it
wiz: a spell to jump the puddle: his bike becomes a kid's bike
dra: the show-off: a wheelie, a fire boost, jumps the whole puddle
phx: look, no hands: arms up, wobbling, straight into the puddle
gun: won't get his boots wet: shoots the puddle dry, rides over
all: clip-in pedals: stops to look at it, forgets to unclip, slowly topples in
sam: one cut parts the puddle down the middle; rides through dry
vik: full send: flat out through it, the puddle is gone and so is the bike; rides on one wheel

title: BIKE: how each fighter rides through a puddle
format: each-character-vs-X, one continuous take: fighters ride along one bike path with a puddle on it, each gets past it their own way
